verification: No transmission tool is enabled; outputs cite domestic evidence and identify missing foreign facts

evidence.text: ai/workflows/eoi_drafting.py draft_eoi_package (TAX-053 read-access check first) builds an EOI draft package for competent-authority review: foreign counterparties from the TAX-050 imported-services review (explicit markers only), optional ISO jurisdiction, per-counterparty transactions with Decimal amounts and domestic evidence IDs that resolve to case records, missing foreign facts (jurisdiction if undeclared, identity/registration, tax residence, services and location unless recorded, consideration received, relationship to taxpayer), open taxpayer questions as outstanding domestic steps, and legal basis from the TAX-052 registry (eoi_request) never asserted (instrument null). SYN-004 yields one package for SYN-FOREIGN-004 citing INV/CTR/PAY-SYN-004-02.

tests/ai/test_eoi_drafting.py (9 tests): package is status draft, for competent_authority, requires_human_approval, approved_by null, transmission enabled false/channel null/sent_at null; transmit() refuses with transmission_not_enabled and an AST check shows the module imports no urllib/http/socket/smtplib/requests/httpx/ftplib; every domestic citation and missing-fact reference resolves to SYN-004 records; six missing foreign facts listed, domestic facts already recorded (service location, declared jurisdiction) are not requested abroad and an invalid jurisdiction is ignored; legal basis no_verified_route (unverified_route with an unverified registry entry), never an instrument; no accusation or enforcement wording; other four scenarios produce no package; unauthenticated/other-tenant/taxpayer/mismatched-tenant input refused; deterministic. .venv-ai pytest tests/ai: 204 passed; ruff/mypy (188 files) pass.
